learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.

observations.text: Preview no-history banner confirmed. Trust chrome 6/6 ignored. Selected The 60% bettor; locked.

1 race: loss, money ratio ×0.8, share 44.4%, pool odds 54.4%. Run to 500: over 99.9%, ratio 1,000+, pool odds 60.0%. Run 2: share 98.8%, ratio 81, pool odds 59.9%; Seen: 50% bettor 91.0%, race 203; reveal unlocked.

Reveal: all five runs at least 98.8%; luck can lead for long; race 203 circled. Win ×1.2/loss ×0.8, three wins and two losses ×1.11. Model: two bettors, no fees, all-in every race. Screenshot inline shows multi-path chart with marked dip; reveal clips right in internal panel. None saved.
